attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moving skip/take into the batched collection DataLoader (keyed only by the fixed name \"ContainedPublishedContentItems\") means if a single GraphQL query contains multiple list fields with different skip/first arguments, only the first invocation's skip/take closure is used for all of them, silently returning wrong pagination results for other list fields in that request."}

reason: Moving skip/take into the batched collection DataLoader (keyed only by the fixed name "ContainedPublishedContentItems") means if a single GraphQL query contains multiple list fields with different skip/first arguments, only the first invocation's skip/take closure is used for all of them, silently returning wrong pagination results for other list fields in that request.
